content: संधानम् .²1 Joining, uniting; वायुः संधानम् <ls>T. Up. 1. 3. 2</ls>. .²2 Union, junction, combination; यदर्धे विच्छिन्नं भवति कृतसंधानमिव तत् <ls>Ś. 1. 9</ls>; <ls>Ku. 5. 27</ls>; <ls>R. 12. 101</ls>. .²3 Mixing, compounding (of medicines <ab>&c.</ab>). .²4 Restoration, repairing. .²5 Fitting, taking an aim, fixing (as an arrow to the bow-string); तत् साधुकृतसंधानं प्रतिसंहर सायकम् <ls>Ś. 1. 11</ls>; अथाग्नियन्त्रसंधानविशेषोदग्रविक्रमान् <ls>Śiva B. 30. 1</ls>; <ls>Śi. 20. 8</ls>. .²6 Alliance, league, friendship, peace; मृद्घटवत् सुखभेद्यो दुःसंधानश्च दुर्जनो भवति <ls>H. 1. 88</ls> (where it has sense 1 also). .²7 A joint; पादजङ्घयोः संधाने गुल्फः <ls>Suśr.</ls> .²8 Attention. .²9 Direction. .²10 Supporting. .²11 Distillation (of liquors). .²12 Spirituous liquor or a kind of it. .²13 A kind of relish eaten to excite thirst. .²14 Preparation of pickles. .²15 Contraction of the skin by means of astringents. .²16 Sour rice-gruel. .²17 Bellmetal (सौराष्ट्र).
